faceCameras.title: Face Capture Cameras
faceCameras.subtitle: {{total}} cameras · {{online}} online · {{offline}} offline · {{disabled}} disabled
faceCameras.empty: No cameras registered yet. Use "Add camera" at the top right to start.

notice.effect: Adding, editing, enabling/disabling a camera or rotating its token takes effect in the face ingest service within 30 seconds.
notice.definition: Online means enabled and a push was received in the last {{minutes}} minutes. Capture, face and parse-failure counts cover the last {{hours}} hours.

confirmDisable.title: Disable camera {{cameraId}}?
confirmDisable.content: The face ingest service will stop accepting pushes from this camera (within 30 seconds). You can enable it again at any time.

confirmRotate.title: Rotate the token of {{cameraId}}?
confirmRotate.content: The old token stops working immediately. The camera must be reconfigured with the new address or its pushes will be rejected. The new address is shown only once.

form.cameraIdHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; must not start with a hyphen; up to 64 characters. Cannot be changed after creation.
form.cameraIdReadonly: The camera ID cannot be changed after creation.
form.storeCodePlaceholder: Select or type a store code
form.storeCodeHint: Search by code or name. Must be an existing store code.
form.storeCodeManualHint: The store list could not be loaded (you may lack store view permission). Type an existing store code directly.

validation.cameraIdInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only; must not start with a hyphen; up to 64 characters
validation.storeCodeRequired: Select or type a store code
validation.storeCodeTooLong: Store code is at most 32 characters
validation.storeCodeInvalid: Store code may only contain letters, digits, underscores and hyphens
validation.macAddressTooLong: MAC address is at most 32 characters

secret.onceOnly: This address is shown only once. After you close this dialog it cannot be viewed again; if it is lost, the token must be rotated.
secret.rotatedNote: The old token of camera {{cameraId}} stopped working immediately. Configure the new address below on the camera.
secret.copyFailed: The browser did not allow automatic copying. The address is selected; press Ctrl/Cmd + C to copy it.
secret.usage: Enter this address as the camera's event push (HTTP listening) address. It works like a password: do not paste it into chats or keep screenshots.

captures.title: Recent captures · {{cameraId}}
captures.metadataOnly: Only metadata of the pushed messages is shown. No images.

errors.generic: The operation failed. Please try again later.
errors.loadFailed: Failed to load the camera list
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage face capture cameras
errors.secretResponseInvalid: The response was incomplete. The camera may already have been created or rotated; refresh the list to check and rotate the token again if needed.
errors.FACE_CAMERA_ID_INVALID: The camera ID format is invalid
errors.FACE_CAMERA_STORE_CODE_INVALID: The store code format is invalid
errors.FACE_CAMERA_STORE_NOT_FOUND: The store does not exist. Choose an existing store code.
errors.FACE_CAMERA_FIELD_INVALID: A field is invalid. Check the lengths and try again.
errors.FACE_CAMERA_TOKEN_CONFLICT: Token generation conflicted. Please try again.
errors.FACE_CAMERA_NOT_FOUND: The camera does not exist. Refresh the list.
